                ...categories.map((category) => ({ id: IssueConstants.ISSUE_PREFIX + category.id, title: category.title })),
                human,
            ];
        }
        const options = [{ id: IssueConstants.OPTION.STATUS, title: IssueConstants.ROW_STATUS }];
        if (this._isLate(order))
            options.push({ id: IssueConstants.OPTION.LATE, title: IssueConstants.ROW_LATE });
        if (IssueConstants.CHANGEABLE_STATUSES.includes(order.status)) {
            options.push({ id: IssueConstants.OPTION.CHANGE, title: IssueConstants.ROW_CHANGE });
        }
        options.push(human);
        return options;
    }
    // ── Menu ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    _showMenu() {
        const { order, delivered } = this._focusOrder();
        newCart.issue_order_code = order ? order.code : '';
        newCart.issue_category = '';
        const body = !order
            ? IssueConstants.MENU_CORPO_SEM_PEDIDO
            : delivered
                ? IssueConstants.MENU_CORPO_ENTREGUE(order.code)
                : IssueConstants.MENU_CORPO_ANDAMENTO(order.code, this._statusLabel(order));
        respostas.push({
            type: 'list',
            body,
            button: IssueConstants.MENU_BOTAO,
            sections: [{ title: IssueConstants.MENU_SECAO, rows: this._options() }],
        });
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_HELP_OPTION;
        return true;
    }
    _handleHelpOption() {
        const options = this._options();
        const byNumber = /^\d+$/.test(texto) && !options.some((option) => option.id === texto)
            ? options[parseInt(texto, 10) - 1]
            : undefined;
        const chosen = byNumber || options.find((option) => option.id === texto)
            || (texto.includes('atendente') ? options.find((option) => option.id === IssueConstants.OPTION.HUMAN) : undefined);
        if (!chosen) {
            respostas.push(IssueConstants.OPCAO_INVALIDA_MENU);
            return this._showMenu();
        }
        const orderCode = newCart.issue_order_code || '';
        if (chosen.id === IssueConstants.OPTION.HUMAN)
            return this._handoff();
        if (chosen.id === IssueConstants.OPTION.STATUS)
            return this._showStatus();
        if (chosen.id === IssueConstants.OPTION.CHANGE) {
            respostas.push(IssueConstants.ALTERAR_PEDIDO(orderCode));
            return this._handoff(true);
        }
        if (chosen.id === IssueConstants.OPTION.NEW_ORDER || chosen.id === IssueConstants.OPTION.MENU) {
            newState = BotState.ORDERING_CAT;
            respostas.push(categoryList('order'));
            return true;
        }
        newCart.issue_category = chosen.id.replace(IssueConstants.ISSUE_PREFIX, '');
        // Atraso: registra direto, o detalhe é o próprio atraso.
        if (newCart.issue_category === 'atraso')
            return this._register(null);
        respostas.push(IssueConstants.PEDIR_DETALHE);
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_ISSUE_DETAIL;
        return true;
    }
    _showStatus() {
        newState = BotState.START;
        const lines = this._activeOrders().map((order) => IssueConstants.STATUS_LINHA(order.code, this._statusLabel(order), this._estimateText(order)));
        respostas.push(IssueConstants.STATUS_CABECALHO + lines.join('\n\n'));
        return true;
    }
    _statusLabel(order) {
        const labels = MessagesConstants.STATUS_MAP;
        if (order.status === 'ready')
            return order.order_type === 'delivery' ? labels.ready_delivery : labels.ready_pickup;
        const known = {
            received: labels.received,
            confirmed: labels.confirmed,
            preparing: labels.preparing,
            out_for_delivery: labels.out_for_delivery,
            delivered: labels.delivered,
        };
        return known[order.status] || order.status;
    }
    _estimateText(order) {
        const target = order.scheduled_for || order.estimated_at;
        if (!target)
            return '';
        const time = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(target));
        if (order.scheduled_for)
            return IssueConstants.AGENDADO_PARA(time);
        return this._isLate(order) ? IssueConstants.PREVISAO_PASSOU(time) : IssueConstants.PREVISAO(time);
    }
    // ── Registro e acompanhamento ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    _handleDetail() {
        const skipped = IssueConstants.SKIP_DETAIL.includes(texto.trim());
        return this._register(skipped ? null : rawText.trim().slice(0, IssueConstants.DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH));
    }
    _register(description) {
        const orderCode = newCart.issue_order_code || null;
        const category = newCart.issue_category || 'outro';
        save_issue = true;
        finalIssue = { order_code: orderCode, category, description };
        newCart.issue_order_code = '';
        newCart.issue_category = '';
        let registered = IssueConstants.REGISTRADO(orderCode);
        const order = orderCode ? recentOrders.find((candidate) => candidate.code === orderCode) : undefined;
        if (order && category === 'atraso') {
            registered += '\n\n' + IssueConstants.STATUS_LINHA(order.code, this._statusLabel(order), this._estimateText(order));
        }
        respostas.push(registered);
        respostas.push({
            type: 'buttons',
            body: IssueConstants.RESOLVEU_PERGUNTA,
            buttons: [
                { id: 'issue_resolvido', title: IssueConstants.RESOLVIDO_BOTAO },
                { id: 'issue_atendente', title: IssueConstants.ATENDENTE_BOTAO },
            ],
        });
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_ISSUE_FOLLOWUP;
        return true;
    }
    _handleFollowup() {
        if (IssueConstants.HUMAN_ANSWERS.some((answer) => texto.includes(answer))) {
            return this._handoff();
        }
        newState = BotState.START;
        if (IssueConstants.RESOLVED_ANSWERS.includes(texto)) {
            respostas.push(IssueConstants.OBRIGADO);
            return true;
        }
        // Qualquer outra coisa: encerra a ajuda e deixa os outros handlers tratarem a mensagem.
        currentState = BotState.START;
        return false;
    }
    _handoff(silent) {
        newState = BotState.HUMAN_HANDOFF;
        request_human_handoff = true;
        handoffCustomerName = customerName || '';
        if (!silent)
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.CONECTANDO_ATENDENTE);
        return true;
    }
}


class CartHandler extends BaseHandler {
    async handle() {
        // Repeat order — sim
        if (texto === 'sim' && currentState === BotState.REPEAT_ORDER) {
            if (lastOrder && Array.isArray(lastOrder.items)) {
                const items = lastOrder.items.map((orderItem) => {
                    const product = products.find((prod) => prod.id === orderItem.id);
                    return product ? { id: product.id, name: product.name, qty: orderItem.qty, price: Number(product.price), menuIdx: products.indexOf(product) + 1 } : null;
                }).filter(Boolean);
                newCart.items = items;
                newState = BotState.ORDERING;
                const { lines, total } = cartSummary(items);
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.PEDIDO_REPETIDO + lines.join('\n') + '\n\n*Total: R$ ' + fmtBRL(total) + '*' + MessagesConstants.PEDIDO_REPETIDO_SUFFIX);
            }
            else {
                newState = BotState.START;
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.PEDIDO_REPETIDO_NAO_ENCONTRADO);
            }
            return true;
        }
        // Repeat order — não
        if ((texto === 'não' || texto === 'nao') && currentState === BotState.REPEAT_ORDER) {
            newState = BotState.START;
            newCart = CartConstants.EMPTY();
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.REPEAT_ORDER_RECUSA);
            respostas.push(mainMenu());
            return true;
        }
        // Qualquer outro texto em repeat_order
        if (currentState === BotState.REPEAT_ORDER) {
            respostas.push(yesNo(MessagesConstants.REPEAT_ORDER_PROMPT));
            return true;
        }
        // Ver carrinho
        if (texto === 'carrinho') {
            if (newCart.items.length === 0) {
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.CARRINHO_VAZIO);
            }
            else {
                const { lines, total } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.CARRINHO_RESUMO_PREFIX + lines.join('\n') + '\n\n*Total: R$ ' + fmtBRL(total) + '*' + MessagesConstants.CARRINHO_RESUMO_SUFFIX);
            }
            return true;
        }
        // Finalizar
        if (texto === 'finalizar') {
            if (newCart.items.length === 0) {
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.CARRINHO_VAZIO);
            }
            else {
                const { lines, total } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
                const minOrder = minOrderValue;
                if (minOrder > 0 && total < minOrder) {
                    respostas.push(MessagesConstants.VALOR_MINIMO(fmtBRL(minOrder), fmtBRL(total)));
                }
                else {
                    newState = BotState.CONFIRMING;
                    respostas.push(confirmBtn(MessagesConstants.CONFIRMAR_PEDIDO(lines.join('\n'), fmtBRL(total))));
                }
            }
            return true;
        }
        // Confirmar pedido
        if ((texto === 'confirmar' || texto === 'sim') && currentState === BotState.CONFIRMING) {
            newCart.scheduled_date = '';
            newCart.scheduled_time = '';
            if (scheduleSlots.length > 0) {
                newState = BotState.AWAITING_WHEN;
                respostas.push(whenBtn());
            }
            else {
                startCheckout();
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}


class SchedulingHandler extends BaseHandler {
    async handle() {
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_WHEN)
            return this._handleWhen();
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_SCHEDULE_DAY)
            return this._handleDay();
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_SCHEDULE_TIME)
            return this._handleTime();
        return false;
    }
    _handleWhen() {
        if (texto === 'when:now' || texto.includes('agora')) {
            startCheckout();
            return true;
        }
        if (texto === 'when:schedule' || texto.includes('agend')) {
            newState = BotState.AWAITING_SCHEDULE_DAY;
            respostas.push(scheduleDayMenu());
            return true;
        }
        respostas.push(whenBtn());
        return true;
    }
    _handleDay() {
        const typedDate = texto.startsWith('day:') ? texto.slice('day:'.length) : parseDate(texto);
        const day = scheduleSlots.find((slotDay) => slotDay.date === typedDate);
        if (!day) {
            respostas.push(scheduleDayMenu());
            return true;
        }
        newCart.scheduled_date = day.date;
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_SCHEDULE_TIME;
        respostas.push(scheduleTimeMenu(day.date));
        return true;
    }
    _handleTime() {
        if (texto === '0' || texto === 'voltar') {
            newState = BotState.AWAITING_SCHEDULE_DAY;
            respostas.push(scheduleDayMenu());
            return true;
        }
        const day = scheduleSlots.find((slotDay) => slotDay.date === newCart.scheduled_date);
        if (!day) {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.AGENDAR_SEM_HORARIOS);
            newCart.scheduled_date = '';
            startCheckout();
            return true;
        }
        const chosen = texto.startsWith('time:') ? texto.slice('time:'.length) : parseTime(texto);
        if (!chosen || !day.times.includes(chosen)) {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.AGENDAR_HORA_INDISPONIVEL(chosen || texto));
            respostas.push(scheduleTimeMenu(day.date));
            return true;
        }
        newCart.scheduled_time = chosen;
        respostas.push(MessagesConstants.AGENDADO_PARA(fmtScheduleDay(day.date), chosen));
        startCheckout();
        return true;
    }
}


class DeliveryHandler extends BaseHandler {
    async handle() {
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_TYPE) {
            let choiceIndex = parseInt(texto) - 1;
            if (isNaN(choiceIndex) || choiceIndex < 0)
                choiceIndex = orderTypes.findIndex((orderType) => orderType.name === texto || orderType.label.toLowerCase() === texto.toLowerCase());
            if (choiceIndex >= 0 && choiceIndex < orderTypes.length) {
                const selectedType = orderTypes[choiceIndex];
                newCart.order_type = selectedType.name;
                if (selectedType.name === 'delivery') {
                    newState = BotState.AWAITING_ADDRESS;
                    respostas.push(MessagesConstants.SOLICITAR_ENDERECO);
                }
                else {
                    newCart.delivery_fee = 0;
                    newState = BotState.AWAITING_PAYMENT;
                    respostas.push(MessagesConstants.TIPO_CONFIRMADO(selectedType.label));
                    respostas.push(paymentList(newCart.split_count));
                }
            }
            else {
                respostas.push(orderTypeBtn());
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_ADDRESS) {
            await this._handleAddress();
            return true;
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_ADDRESS_NUMBER) {
            await this._handleAddressNumber();
            return true;
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.OFFER_PICKUP) {
            if (texto === 'sim') {
                newCart.order_type = 'retirada';
                newCart.delivery_fee = 0;
                newState = BotState.AWAITING_PAYMENT;
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.RETIRADA_CONFIRMADA);
                respostas.push(paymentList(newCart.split_count));
            }
            else {
                newState = BotState.AWAITING_ADDRESS;
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.OUTRO_ENDERECO(estCity || ''));
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    _coordsConfigured() {
        return estLat !== 0 || estLng !== 0;
    }
    _buildEtaLine(calcFee, routeMin, routeKm) {
        if (routeMin <= 0)
            return '';
        return calcFee === 0
            ? MessagesConstants.ETA_LINE_GRATIS(routeMin, routeKm.toFixed(1))
            : MessagesConstants.ETA_LINE(fmtBRL(calcFee), routeMin, routeKm.toFixed(1));
    }
    async _applyRoute(lat, lng, addressLabel) {
        const distance = haversine(estLat, estLng, lat, lng);
        if (this._coordsConfigured() && distance > maxRadiusKm) {
            newCart.address = addressLabel;
            newState = BotState.OFFER_PICKUP;
            respostas.push(offerPickupBtn(MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_FORA_AREA(maxRadiusKm)));
            return;
        }
        let routeKm = 0;
        let routeMin = 0;
        if (this._coordsConfigured()) {
            const route = await routingProvider.route(estLat, estLng, lat, lng);
            if (route) {
                routeKm = route.km;
                routeMin = route.min;
            }
        }
        const { total: cartSubtotal } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
        const calcFee = calcDeliveryFee(routeKm, routeMin, cartSubtotal);
        newCart.address = addressLabel;
        newCart.delivery_fee = calcFee;
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_COMPLEMENT;
        respostas.push(locationMsg(lat, lng, MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_ENTREGA_TITULO, addressLabel));
        respostas.push(MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_ENCONTRADO(addressLabel, this._buildEtaLine(calcFee, routeMin, routeKm)));
    }
    async _handleAddress() {
        const estCityName = estCity.split(',')[0].trim().toLowerCase();
        if (texto === '__location__' && location_lat != null && location_lng != null) {
            const lat = Number(location_lat);
            const lng = Number(location_lng);
            const distance = haversine(estLat, estLng, lat, lng);
            if (this._coordsConfigured() && distance > maxRadiusKm) {
                newCart.address = MessagesConstants.LOCALIZACAO_COMPARTILHADA;
                newState = BotState.OFFER_PICKUP;
                respostas.push(offerPickupBtn(MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_FORA_AREA(maxRadiusKm)));
                return;
            }
            let routeKm = 0;
            let routeMin = 0;
            if (this._coordsConfigured()) {
                const route = await routingProvider.route(estLat, estLng, lat, lng);
                if (route) {
                    routeKm = route.km;
                    routeMin = route.min;
                }
            }
            let addressLabel = MessagesConstants.LOCALIZACAO_COMPARTILHADA;
            const reverseResult = await geocodingProvider.reverse(lat, lng);
            if (reverseResult?.address) {
                const addr = reverseResult.address;
                const parts = [addr.road, addr.house_number, addr.suburb || addr.neighbourhood, addr.city || addr.town || addr.village, addr.state_code || addr.state].filter(Boolean);
                if (parts.length > 0)
                    addressLabel = parts.join(', ');
            }
            const { total: cartSubtotal } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
            const calcFee = calcDeliveryFee(routeKm, routeMin, cartSubtotal);
            newCart.address = addressLabel;
            newCart.delivery_fee = calcFee;
            newState = BotState.AWAITING_COMPLEMENT;
            respostas.push(locationMsg(lat, lng, MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_ENTREGA_TITULO, addressLabel));
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.LOCALIZACAO_RECEBIDA(addressLabel, this._buildEtaLine(calcFee, routeMin, routeKm)));
            return;
        }
        const input = texto.trim();
        const cepDigits = input.replace(/\D/g, '');
        let addressToGeocode = input;
        let cepInfo = null;
        if (cepDigits.length === 8) {
            cepInfo = await cepProvider.lookup(cepDigits);
            const nonFormattingChars = input.replace(/[\d\s.\-]/g, '');
            const isCepOnly = nonFormattingChars.length === 0;
            if (isCepOnly && cepInfo) {
                const streetLabel = [cepInfo.logradouro, cepInfo.bairro, cepInfo.localidade, cepInfo.uf].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
                newCart.address_street_temp = JSON.stringify({
                    logradouro: cepInfo.logradouro || '',
                    bairro: cepInfo.bairro || '',
                    localidade: cepInfo.localidade || '',
                    uf: cepInfo.uf || '',
                    cep: cepInfo.cep || '',
                });
                newState = BotState.AWAITING_ADDRESS_NUMBER;
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.CEP_ENCONTRADO(cepInfo.cep, streetLabel));
                _earlyResponse = buildPayload();
                return;
            }
            if (cepInfo) {
                const parts = [cepInfo.logradouro, cepInfo.bairro, cepInfo.localidade, cepInfo.uf].filter(Boolean);
                if (parts.length > 0)
                    addressToGeocode = parts.join(', ');
            }
        }
        const streetAndNumMatch = input.match(/^(.+?\s+\d+)/);
        const streetAndNum = streetAndNumMatch ? streetAndNumMatch[1].trim() : input;
        let geoResult = await geocodingProvider.search(addressToGeocode + ', Brasil');
        if (!geoResult && estCity && !addressToGeocode.toLowerCase().includes(estCityName)) {
            const withCity = addressToGeocode + ', ' + estCity;
            geoResult = await geocodingProvider.search(withCity + ', Brasil');
            if (geoResult)
                addressToGeocode = withCity;
        }
        if (!geoResult && estCity && streetAndNum !== addressToGeocode) {
            const stripped = streetAndNum + ', ' + estCity;
            geoResult = await geocodingProvider.search(stripped + ', Brasil');
            if (geoResult)
                addressToGeocode = stripped;
        }
        if (!geoResult) {
            const hint = cepInfo
                ? MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_HINT_CEP(cepInfo.cep, addressToGeocode)
                : MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_HINT(estCity);
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_NAO_ENCONTRADO(hint));
            return;
        }
        await this._applyRoute(parseFloat(geoResult.lat), parseFloat(geoResult.lon), addressToGeocode);
    }
    async _handleAddressNumber() {
        const numberInput = texto.trim();
        let streetInfo = {};
        try {
            streetInfo = JSON.parse(newCart.address_street_temp || '{}');
        }
        catch (error) { }
        if (!streetInfo['localidade']) {
            newState = BotState.AWAITING_ADDRESS;
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_INVALIDO_RETRY(estCity || ''));
            return;
        }
        const numLabel = numberInput === 's/n' ? 'S/N' : numberInput;
        const fullAddress = [streetInfo['logradouro'], numLabel, streetInfo['bairro'], streetInfo['localidade'], streetInfo['uf']].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
        newCart.address_street_temp = null;
        const geoResult = await geocodingProvider.search(fullAddress + ', Brasil');
        if (!geoResult) {
            const { total: cartSubtotal } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
            const fee = calcDeliveryFee(0, 0, cartSubtotal);
            const mapsLink = 'https://maps.google.com/?q=' + encodeURIComponent(fullAddress);
            newCart.address = fullAddress;
            newCart.delivery_fee = fee;
            const feeMsg = fee === 0 ? MessagesConstants.FRETE_GRATIS : MessagesConstants.TAXA_ENTREGA(fmtBRL(fee));
            newState = BotState.AWAITING_COMPLEMENT;
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.ENDERECO_CONFIRMADO_CEP(fullAddress, mapsLink, feeMsg));
            return;
        }
        await this._applyRoute(parseFloat(geoResult.lat), parseFloat(geoResult.lon), fullAddress);
    }
}

                newCart = CartConstants.EMPTY();

                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.MISTO_VALOR(fmtBRL(total), nonCashTypes[0].label));

                newState = BotState.AWAITING_MIXED_METHOD;

            return true;
        }
        respostas.push(paymentList(newCart.split_count));

class ReservationHandler extends BaseHandler {
    async handle() {
        if (currentState === BotState.RESERVING) {
            return this._handleReserving();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.CONFIRMING_RESERVATION && texto === 'sim') {
            return this._handleConfirmReservation();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.CONFIRMING_RESERVATION && (texto === 'não' || texto === 'nao')) {
            newReservationTemp = {};
            newState = BotState.START;
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_CANCELADA);
            respostas.push(mainMenu());
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    _handleReserving() {
        const dateValue = parseDate(texto);
        const timeValue = parseTime(texto);
        const sizeValue = parsePeople(texto);
        const missing = [];
        if (!dateValue)
            missing.push('📆 data');
        if (!timeValue)
            missing.push('🕗 horário');
        if (!sizeValue)
            missing.push(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_FALTA_PESSOAS);
        if (missing.length > 0) {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_FALTANDO(missing.join(', ')));
            return true;
        }
        // Qual mesa está livre no horário quem decide é a agenda da API, ao gravar.
        const hasTableForParty = restaurantTables.some((table) => table.capacity >= sizeValue);
        if (!hasTableForParty) {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_SEM_MESA(sizeValue, fmtDate(dateValue), timeValue));
            return true;
        }
        newReservationTemp = { date: dateValue, time: timeValue, party_size: sizeValue };
        newState = BotState.CONFIRMING_RESERVATION;
        respostas.push(confirmBtn(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_RESUMO(fmtDate(dateValue), timeValue, sizeValue)));
        return true;
    }
    _handleConfirmReservation() {
        const reservationData = newReservationTemp;
        if (!reservationData || !reservationData.date) {
            newState = BotState.START;
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_DADOS_INVALIDOS);
            return true;
        }
        const reservationCode = generateReservationCode(tel);
        save_reservation = true;
        finalReservation = {
            tel,
            code: reservationCode,
            customer_name: customerName,
            date: reservationData.date,
            time: reservationData.time,
            party_size: reservationData.party_size,
        };
        newReservationTemp = {};
        newState = BotState.START;
        const estabAddr = estAddress;
        const mapsLink = estabAddr ? MessagesConstants.RESERVA_MAPS_LINE(estabAddr) : '';
        const addrLine = estabAddr ? MessagesConstants.RESERVA_ADDR_LINE(estabAddr, mapsLink) : '';
        respostas.push(MessagesConstants.RESERVA_CONFIRMADA(fmtDate(reservationData.date), reservationData.time, reservationData.party_size, reservationCode, addrLine));
        return true;
    }
}

class OrderingHandler extends BaseHandler {
    async handle() {
        if (currentState === BotState.BROWSING_CATEGORIES || currentState === BotState.ORDERING_CAT) {
            return this._handleCategories();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.BROWSING_ITEMS || currentState === BotState.ORDERING_ITEMS) {
            return this._handleItems();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_SIZE) {
            return this._handleSize();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_QTY) {
            return this._handleQuantity();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_MORE) {
            return this._handleMore();
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.AWAITING_ITEM_NOTE) {
            return this._handleNote();
        }
        return false;
    }
    _handleCategories() {
        const catInput = texto.replace(/^(order_cat:|cat:)/, '');
        if (catInput === 'back' || texto === '0' || texto === 'voltar') {
            newState = BotState.START;
            respostas.push(mainMenu());
            return true;
        }
        const allCategories = [...new Set(products.map((product) => product.category || 'Outros'))];
        const foundCategory = allCategories.find((category) => category.toLowerCase() === catInput.toLowerCase());
        if (foundCategory) {
            newCart.browse_category = foundCategory;
            newState = BotState.ORDERING_ITEMS;
            respostas.push(itemsList(foundCategory, 'order', 0));
        }
        else {
            respostas.push(categoryList('order'));
        }
        return true;
    }
    _handleItems() {
        const currentCategory = newCart.browse_category || '';
        if (texto === 'cat:back' || texto === 'order_cat:back' || texto === '0' || texto === 'voltar') {
            newState = BotState.ORDERING_CAT;
            respostas.push(categoryList('order'));
            return true;
        }
        if (texto.startsWith('page:')) {
            const pageParts = texto.split(':');
            const pageContext = pageParts[1];
            const pageCategoryRaw = pageParts.slice(2, -1).join(':');
            const pageNumber = parseInt(pageParts[pageParts.length - 1]);
            const resolvedCategory = products.map((product) => product.category || 'Outros')
                .find((category) => category.toLowerCase() === pageCategoryRaw.toLowerCase()) || pageCategoryRaw;
            respostas.push(itemsList(resolvedCategory, pageContext, pageNumber));
            return true;
        }
        const allEntries = menuEntries(currentCategory);
        const PAGE_SIZE = 9;
        const currentPage = newCart.browse_page || 0;
        const pageStart = currentPage * PAGE_SIZE;
        if (texto === 'próxima' || texto === 'proxima' || texto === 'próximo' || texto === 'proximo') {
            if (allEntries.length > pageStart + PAGE_SIZE) {
                newCart.browse_page = currentPage + 1;
                respostas.push(itemsList(currentCategory, 'order', currentPage + 1));
            }
            else {
                respostas.push(itemsList(currentCategory, 'order', 0));
            }
            return true;
        }
        const itemNumber = parseInt(texto);
        const selectedEntry = !isNaN(itemNumber) ? allEntries[itemNumber - 1] : undefined;
        if (!selectedEntry) {
            respostas.push(itemsList(currentCategory, 'order', currentPage));
            return true;
        }
        newCart.browse_page = 0;
        if (selectedEntry.variants.length > 1) {
            newCart.pending_group = selectedEntry.product.variant_group || '';
            newState = BotState.AWAITING_SIZE;
            respostas.push(variantMenu(selectedEntry));
            return true;
        }
        this._askQuantity(selectedEntry.product);
        return true;
    }
    _askQuantity(selectedProduct) {
        newCart.pending_item_id = selectedProduct.id;
        newCart.pending_item_name = selectedProduct.name;
        newCart.pending_group = '';
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_QTY;
        const descriptionText = selectedProduct.description ? '\n\n_' + selectedProduct.description + '_' : '';
        respostas.push({
            type: 'buttons',
            body: MessagesConstants.PRODUTO_DETALHE(selectedProduct.name, fmtBRL(selectedProduct.price), descriptionText),
            buttons: [
                { id: 'qty:1', title: '✅ Adicionar (1un)' },
                { id: 'qty:more', title: '✏️ Outra qtd' },
                { id: 'item:back', title: '↩️ Voltar' },
            ],
        });
    }
    _handleSize() {
        const variants = products.filter((product) => !!newCart.pending_group && product.variant_group === newCart.pending_group);
        if (texto === 'item:back' || texto === '0' || texto === 'voltar' || variants.length === 0) {
            newCart.pending_group = '';
            newState = BotState.ORDERING_ITEMS;
            respostas.push(itemsList(newCart.browse_category || '', 'order', 0));
            return true;
        }
        const normalize = (value) => value.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
        const chosenId = texto.startsWith('size:') ? texto.slice('size:'.length) : '';
        const chosenIndex = parseInt(texto) - 1;
        const chosen = variants.find((variant) => String(variant.id) === chosenId)
            || variants[chosenIndex]
            || variants.find((variant) => !!variant.variant_label && normalize(texto).includes(normalize(variant.variant_label)));
        if (!chosen) {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.TAMANHO_INVALIDO);
            respostas.push(variantMenu({ product: variants[0], variants, title: variantBaseName(variants[0]) }));
            return true;
        }
        this._askQuantity(chosen);
        return true;
    }
    _handleQuantity() {
        if (texto === 'item:back') {
            newState = BotState.ORDERING_ITEMS;
            respostas.push(itemsList(newCart.browse_category || '', 'order', newCart.browse_page || 0));
            return true;
        }
        if (texto === 'qty:more') {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.QTD_SOLICITAR);
            return true;
        }
        let quantity = null;
        if (texto.startsWith('qty:')) {
            quantity = parseInt(texto.replace('qty:', ''));
        }
        else {
            const parsed = parseInt(texto);
            if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= 1 && parsed <= 99)
                quantity = parsed;
        }
        if (!quantity || quantity < 1) {
            respostas.push({
                type: 'buttons',
                body: MessagesConstants.QTD_INVALIDA,
                buttons: [{ id: 'qty:1', title: '✅ Adicionar (1un)' }, { id: 'item:back', title: '↩️ Voltar' }],
            });
            return true;
        }
        const foundProduct = products.find((product) => String(product.id) === String(newCart.pending_item_id));
        if (!foundProduct) {
            newState = BotState.START;
            respostas.push(mainMenu());
            return true;
        }
        const existingItem = newCart.items.find((cartItem) => cartItem.id === foundProduct.id);
        if (existingItem) {
            existingItem.qty += quantity;
        }
        else {
            newCart.items.push({ id: foundProduct.id, name: foundProduct.name, qty: quantity, price: Number(foundProduct.price), menuIdx: products.indexOf(foundProduct) + 1 });
        }
        newCart.pending_item_id = null;
        newCart.pending_item_name = '';
        newCart.last_item_id = foundProduct.id;
        const { lines: cartLines, total } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_MORE;
        respostas.push(this._moreButtons(MessagesConstants.ITEM_ADICIONADO(foundProduct.name, quantity)
            + MessagesConstants.CARRINHO_ATUAL + cartLines.join('\n')
            + MessagesConstants.TOTAL_PARCIAL(fmtBRL(total))
            + MessagesConstants.ADICIONAR_MAIS_OU_FINALIZAR));
        return true;
    }
    // Depois de adicionar: mais itens, observação para o item que acabou de entrar, ou finalizar.
    _moreButtons(body) {
        const buttons = [{ id: '__add_more__', title: '➕ Adicionar mais' }];
        if (newCart.last_item_id)
            buttons.push({ id: '__item_note__', title: MessagesConstants.OBSERVACAO_BOTAO });
        buttons.push({ id: 'finalizar', title: '✅ Finalizar' });
        return { type: 'buttons', body, buttons };
    }
    _lastItem() {
        return newCart.items.find((cartItem) => cartItem.id === newCart.last_item_id);
    }
    _handleNote() {
        const item = this._lastItem();
        newState = BotState.AWAITING_MORE;
        const raw = rawText.trim();
        const skipped = ['pular', 'nao', 'não', 'n', '-', '0', 'voltar'].includes(texto.trim());
        if (!item || skipped || !raw) {
            respostas.push(this._moreButtons(MessagesConstants.OBSERVACAO_PULADA + MessagesConstants.ADICIONAR_MAIS_OU_FINALIZAR));
            return true;
        }
        item.note = raw.slice(0, 140);
        respostas.push(this._moreButtons(MessagesConstants.OBSERVACAO_ANOTADA(item.name, item.note) + MessagesConstants.ADICIONAR_MAIS_OU_FINALIZAR));
        return true;
    }
    _handleMore() {
        if (texto === '__item_note__') {
            const item = this._lastItem();
            if (item) {
                newState = BotState.AWAITING_ITEM_NOTE;
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.OBSERVACAO_PERGUNTA(item.name));
                return true;
            }
        }
        if (texto === '__add_more__') {
            const savedCategory = newCart.browse_category;
            newState = savedCategory ? BotState.ORDERING_ITEMS : BotState.ORDERING_CAT;
            respostas.push(savedCategory ? itemsList(savedCategory, 'order', 0) : categoryList('order'));
            return true;
        }
        if (texto === 'finalizar') {
            const { lines, total } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
            const minOrder = minOrderValue;
            if (minOrder > 0 && total < minOrder) {
                respostas.push(MessagesConstants.ORDEM_MINIMO_ADDMORE(fmtBRL(minOrder), fmtBRL(total)));
                newState = BotState.AWAITING_MORE;
                respostas.push({ type: 'buttons', body: MessagesConstants.ADICIONAR_MAIS_MINIMO, buttons: [{ id: '__add_more__', title: '➕ Adicionar mais' }] });
            }
            else {
                newState = BotState.CONFIRMING;
                respostas.push(confirmBtn(MessagesConstants.CONFIRMAR_PEDIDO(lines.join('\n'), fmtBRL(total))));
            }
            return true;
        }
        respostas.push(this._moreButtons(MessagesConstants.ADICIONAR_MAIS_PERGUNTA));
        return true;
    }
}


class FallbackHandler extends BaseHandler {
    async handle() {
        const textLines = texto.split(/[\n,+]/).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
        const parsedItems = [];
        const unrecognizedLines = [];
        for (const line of textLines) {
            const indexQtyMatch = line.match(/^(\d+)\s*[xX×]\s*(\d+)$/);
            if (indexQtyMatch) {
                const productIndex = parseInt(indexQtyMatch[1]) - 1;
                const quantity = parseInt(indexQtyMatch[2]);
                if (quantity < 1) {
                    unrecognizedLines.push(line);
                    continue;
                }
                if (productIndex >= 0 && products && productIndex < products.length) {
                    const product = products[productIndex];
                    parsedItems.push({ id: product.id, name: product.name, qty: quantity, price: Number(product.price), menuIdx: productIndex + 1 });
                }
                else {
                    unrecognizedLines.push(line);
                }
                continue;
            }
            const nameQtyMatch = line.match(/^(.+?)\s*[xX×]\s*(\d+)$/);
            if (nameQtyMatch) {
                const normalize = (source) => source.toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '');
                const searchTerm = normalize(nameQtyMatch[1].trim());
                const quantity = parseInt(nameQtyMatch[2]);
                const foundProduct = products && products.find((product) => normalize(product.name).includes(searchTerm));
                if (foundProduct && quantity >= 1) {
                    parsedItems.push({ id: foundProduct.id, name: foundProduct.name, qty: quantity, price: Number(foundProduct.price), menuIdx: products.indexOf(foundProduct) + 1 });
                }
                else {
                    unrecognizedLines.push(line);
                }
                continue;
            }
            const numberOnlyMatch = line.match(/^(\d+)$/);
            if (numberOnlyMatch) {
                const productNumber = parseInt(numberOnlyMatch[1]);
                if (productNumber >= 1 && products && productNumber <= products.length) {
                    const product = products[productNumber - 1];
                    parsedItems.push({ id: product.id, name: product.name, qty: 1, price: Number(product.price), menuIdx: productNumber });
                }
                else {
                    unrecognizedLines.push(line);
                }
            }
            else {
                unrecognizedLines.push(line);
            }
        }
        if (parsedItems.length > 0) {
            // Desduplicar itens da mesma mensagem
            const dedupedItems = [];
            for (const parsedItem of parsedItems) {
                const existingInDeduped = dedupedItems.find((deduped) => deduped.id === parsedItem.id);
                if (existingInDeduped) {
                    existingInDeduped.qty += parsedItem.qty;
                }
                else {
                    dedupedItems.push({ ...parsedItem });
                }
            }
            // Mergear com carrinho existente
            const hadItemsBefore = newCart.items.length > 0;
            for (const dedupedItem of dedupedItems) {
                const existingInCart = newCart.items.find((cartItem) => cartItem.id === dedupedItem.id);
                if (existingInCart) {
                    existingInCart.qty += dedupedItem.qty;
                }
                else {
                    newCart.items.push(dedupedItem);
                }
            }
            newState = BotState.ORDERING;
            const addedLines = dedupedItems.map((dedupedItem) => '• [' + (dedupedItem.menuIdx || '') + '] ' + dedupedItem.name + ' — R$ ' + fmtBRL(dedupedItem.price) + ' × ' + dedupedItem.qty + ' — R$ ' + fmtBRL(dedupedItem.price * dedupedItem.qty)).join('\n');
            const { lines: cartLines, total } = cartSummary(newCart.items);
            let msg = MessagesConstants.ADICIONAR_TEXTO + addedLines;
            if (hadItemsBefore) {
                msg += MessagesConstants.CARRINHO_ATUAL + cartLines.join('\n') + '\n' + MessagesConstants.TOTAL_LINE_SIMPLES(fmtBRL(total));
            }
            else {
                msg += MessagesConstants.TOTAL_PARCIAL(fmtBRL(total));
            }
            if (unrecognizedLines.length > 0)
                msg += MessagesConstants.NAO_RECONHECIDO(unrecognizedLines.join(', '));
            msg += MessagesConstants.INSTRUCOES_ORDERING;
            respostas.push(msg);
            return true;
        }
        if (currentState === BotState.START) {
            respostas.push(msgWelcome);
            respostas.push(mainMenu());
        }
        else {
            respostas.push(MessagesConstants.NAO_ENTENDI);
        }
        return true;
    }
}
